notes.title: GAME REBUILT FROM ZERO
notes.content:
Lost Alone Ep.1 - Little Sister was rebuilt from scratch!
Get ready for a new [b]adventure[/b]!

If you have already played [b]Lost Alone Ep.1 - Little Sister[/b], you are officially invited to return to the house that gave you two hours of terror.

The game has been completely rebuilt from scratch and will be like playing a [b]NEW GAME[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40960555/6e7ff7df97ade6d48541ccc50aa60ce85f1c9454.png[/img]
[list]
[*] House completely rebuilt from scratch.
[*] New cutscenes.
[*] Added saves.
[*] New rooms.
[*] New jumpscare.
[*] New spirits.
[*] New puzzles.
[*] Improved graphics.
[*] Partial support for controllers.
[*] [b]A NEW GAME IS WAITING FOR YOU![/b]
[/list]

notes.title: ARE YOU THE FASTEST?!
notes.content:
New day and new update!
In version 1.6.0 of Lost Alone EP.1 - Little Sister, you will find many new features! First of all: the Time Event!
By starting this mode, you will be able to set your own personal speed record!
Finish Lost Alone as quickly as possible! Break all records and join the Hall Of Fame!
